notes.title: Road to Early Access #4: Surviving a Dying Frontier [Video]
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy folks! [/b]

We’re back on the trail with Episode 4 of our Western Rye Devlog! In this update, we’re giving y’all a sneak peek of in-game survival gameplay, a taste of what it really means to endure in a dying frontier.

From dust-choked towns and twisted trails to the chilling echoes of something not quite natural... this short video aims to capture the raw experience we're building: a Wild West like you’ve never seen before.

We want players to feel every bullet, every bad decision, every long night under cursed skies. This ain’t your grandpappy’s cowboy tale it’s about surviving a world that's just as likely to eat you alive as it is to ride beside you.

Thank you for your support! 
Ride safe. See ya down the trail, pardner

notes.title: Road to Early Access #2: Creatures & Combat [Video]
Road to Early Access #1: Exploration [Video]
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy folks! [/b]

We want to sincerely apologize for the long silence. Over the past years, we’ve heard your frustrations loud and clear, and we fully understand the disappointment it caused. Western Rye is a project we care deeply about, and while we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, we should have done a better job keeping you in the loop.

Today marks the first step in rebuilding that trust with the start of our new devlog series: Road to Early Access. Thank you for your patience, we’re excited to finally share our journey with you.
